(3) She sits cross-legged on the couch, looking into the large shopping bag with a big smile, her hands resting on the edges of the paper bag. (4) Reaching into the paper bag, she pulls out a bright lime green fabric dust bag with a white brand logo printed on it. (5) She carefully removes a grey leather handbag from the green dust bag, holding it up to the camera to show the color and texture. (6) She stands up to demonstrate carrying the bag in her hand, adjusting her black skirt and sweater while the camera stays at eye level. (7) She then shifts the bag to her shoulder, showing the profile of the bag against her black outfit in the well-lit room. (8) She adjusts the leather strap of the bag, showing the metal buckle and the looping mechanism in a close-up shot. (9) She demonstrates the crossbody carrying style, turning side-to-side to show the bag's position relative to her waist and the couch in the background. (10) She opens the bag to show the interior lining and pockets, using her hands to pull the leather opening wide for the camera. (11) She poses with the bag again, smiling and gesturing towards it while standing in front of the galaxy-themed wall art. (12) A quick replay cut shows her throwing the original black backpack away again for emphasis. (13) She stands holding the new grey bag, looking happy and talking towards the camera operator who is off-screen.
